newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken says Investor CEO its vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken says Investor CEO its vice chairman.

text.p: Swedish bank S-E-Banken said on Tuesday that Claes Dahlback, chief executive of investment company Investor, had been elected vice chairman at its annual general meeting.

The two groups are closely linked as Investor is the key investment vehicle in the Wallenberg family's financial empire and S-E-Banken is seen as somewhat of a family bank because the Wallenbergs once founded a part of it.
Analysts have speculated on Dahlback chairing the bank next year.
Jacob Wallenberg, who will take over as S-E-Banken's managing director, also took a seat on the board, the bank added.
